rows.description: Keep domestic box office, country or grouped-territory box office, worldwide aggregates, Netflix views, Netflix hours, Nielsen minutes, rank-only charts and linear measurements separate.
Never combine incompatible units, overlapping territories or mismatched periods.
Every snapshot: source, measured interval, publication date, import date, territory, metric, unit, rank, value or explicit unknown, actual/estimate/simulation status, revision, stable title mapping.
Three input modes: authorized provider integration, dated imported reference data, labeled save-world simulation.
Purchase no data service; public access is not unrestricted reuse.
Real reference charts stay apart from save-world charts; generated results are never presented as published facts.
Display the measured week.
Handle stale reports, unavailable figures, rank-only data, partial reports, corrections, outages, revisions and duplicate imports.
Unknown is not zero; outside the top ten is not rank eleven.
Infer no private retention or completion from public rankings.
Outside productions give rankings and market context; no autonomous celebrity careers.
Institution, edition, section or category, eligibility, submission, consideration, selection or nomination, voting or jury, result, recognition.
A named awards inventory: Oscars, Television Academy Emmys, NATAS, International Emmys, BAFTA, Actor Awards, Golden Globes, Spirit Awards, Critics Choice, Gotham, AACTA, César, Goya, Annie Awards.
A festival inventory: Cannes, Venice, Berlin, Sundance, TIFF, Annecy, IDFA, Busan.
Extract an edition’s and category’s rules before enabling authoritative eligibility decisions.
Never treat all Emmy organizations as one competition or a festival’s sections as one rulebook.

Store recipient rules, role restrictions, runtime thresholds, territory, qualifying windows, premiere restrictions, submission authority, deadlines and their zones, voting rounds, nominee counts, tie rules, ceremony dates and sources.
Track submission, selection, acceptance and exhibition separately.
Prior selection itself may affect eligibility, not only public screening.
The player can’t submit or distribute a whole production without the authority.
Use published annual calendars; never reuse a previous year’s date as verified.
Unpublished future rules are unknown or explicitly projected simulation.
Never nominate old work years later unless the actual rule permits it.
A functioning anonymous competitive field with stable IDs, simulated strength and exposure, persisted for the competition.
Follow published voting structures without claiming knowledge of real private ballots.
Outside nominees and winners stay unnamed in every screen and message.
The player’s states: ineligible, eligible, not entered, entered, not nominated, nominated, did not win, won, disqualified.
A loss says only that the player didn’t win, and the nomination is kept.
A win is recorded permanently: award, category, edition, work, performance, eligible recipient status.
Being in a Best Picture winner doesn’t make the player its recipient; ensemble conditions apply as written.
Attendance doesn’t guarantee victory, and no cash prize is invented.
An interactive ceremony and a concise recap of the same settled result.
Reloading or changing presentation never changes who won.
Awards influence visibility and access without rewriting contracts, depositing money or guaranteeing another award.
Persist applications, auditions, negotiations, contracts, roles, collaborators, scenes, footage, credits, earnings, reception, nominations, awards and relationships.

Report distributions and failures, not only successes.
Trace representative features: UI, validated command, state or event, downstream consumer, visible result, save and reload.
Fix defects, rerun what they touch, and run the repository gate on the final intended commit; pending tests are never called passed.
Resumable checkpoints: completed requirement IDs, remaining work, branch and commit, test commands and results, blockers, next action.
Each genuine external blocker says what is unavailable, what was attempted, what it affects and what honest fallback exists.
